_comment: Pinned exceptions for scripts/validation/dead-exports.mjs (task #374). Every entry is an exported symbol under client/src/ or shared/ that NO other module imports — pre-existing findings from when the symbol-level gate was introduced. This list is MECHANICALLY shrink-only: the gate carries a frozen manifest of exactly these file#symbol keys and fails on any entry outside it, so adding or substituting entries here does nothing but fail the gate (allowlist-growth). The only allowed edit is REMOVING an entry together with resolving its export (delete it, drop the `export` keyword, or wire it up); stale pins (symbol imported again, or gone with the entry left behind) also fail. The analytics helpers this gate was filed over are NOT pinned — they were deleted, which is what every new finding must do.
